descriptions.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!的地表正在对我们的建设活动表现出前所未有的反应。一种无法甄别的粘稠物质开始从关键设施的地基中渗出。

这种渗出物是一种深红色液体，外观呈胶状，摸起来极具粘性。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切希望进一步研究这种排放物。虽然目前它仅仅带来些许不便，但为确保[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的安全，最好还是谨慎行事。
descriptions.en:
The surface of §Y[Root.GetName]§! is exhibiting an unprecedented reaction to our construction efforts. An unidentified viscous substance is beginning to ooze out from the foundations of key installations.

The ooze is some kind of crimson liquid; gelatinous in appearance but extremely adhesive to the touch.

Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are eager to study this discharge further. Currently it is a mere inconvenience, but it would be prudent to ensure the safety of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!报告了关于神秘猩红色粘液的新进展，结果令人不安。

这种物质正变得难以控制，在受影响的区域以更快的速度涌现。

这种粘液并非毫无益处。随着其凝固，其粘合特性变得更加显著，有效地形成了一种天然水泥，对于我们建设工作的进展可以作为有效补充。

然而，令人担忧的是，这种物质几乎无法从任何接触它的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]身上清除。尝试治疗和研究受影响的工人将使我们能够收集更多信息，但会减缓建设进度。
descriptions.en:
§Y[Root.GetName]§! reports troubling developments regarding the strange crimson ooze.

The substance is becoming unmanageable, emerging at a greater rate throughout the afflicted areas.

The ooze is not without its benefits. As it coagulates, its adhesive properties become more pronounced, effectively forming a natural cement that can be used to supplement our construction efforts.

Worryingly though, the substance proves nearly impossible to remove from any [Owner.GetColonistPlural] who come into contact with it. Attempting to treat and study those affected would allow us to gather more information but would slow construction progress.

label.zh: 治疗并研究沾染粘液的人。

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!的建设以异常顺利的速度持续推进，但那种粘稠物质的出现已不再仅限于我们设施的地基部分。

多处地点发现了渗漏的裂缝。最初，只有[Root.GetName]上的非本土物体受到这种物质的影响，但现在它正在无差别地扩散。

该物质现已吞噬了[Root.GetName]表面的大部分区域，并迅速凝结成厚厚的矿物凝结物，将[Root.GetName]包围。

通过代价高昂的反复试验，我们的工程师找到了一种方法来减轻进一步的损害，并高效地采集这种物质。然而，这只能通过向这种粘液让出大量土地来实现。
descriptions.en:
Construction on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has continued at an exceptional pace, but the emergence of the viscous substance is no longer limited to just the foundations of our installations.

Hemorrhaging fissures have been discovered in multiple locations. Initially only non-native objects to [Root.GetName] were being affected by the substance, but now it is spreading indiscriminately.

The material has now consumed a large portion of the surface of [Root.GetName] and is rapidly congealing into a thick mineral coagulate that has surrounded [Root.GetName].

Through costly trial and error, our engineers have found a way to mitigate further damage as well as efficiently harvest the substance. This was only possible at the expense of ceding significant ground to the ooze.

descriptions.zh:
在对§Y[Root.GetName]§!上受影响的工人进行深入研究和治疗后，我们的科学家已成功隔离出问题的根源。

尽管表面上看上去是一种粘稠凝胶状物质，实际上这是一群与星球形成共生关系的寄生微生物。这些寄生虫在[Root.GetName]的地壳下分解有机物，并将其回收转化为新的物质。

[Root.GetName]的开发活动扰乱了它们的自然生命周期，导致它们对我们引入其生态系统的外来物质产生了反应。

我们的科研团队相信，假以时日，我们能够找到与这些生命体和谐共处的方法，并将其独特的生物学特性整合到[Root.GetName]的生产流程中。
descriptions.en:
After intense study and treatment of the afflicted workers on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, our scientists have isolated the root cause of the problem.

What initially presented as a viscous gelatinous substance, is in fact a collection of parasitic microorganisms that form a symbiotic relationship with the planet. The parasites decompose organic matter beneath the crust of [Root.GetName] and recycle it into new material.

The disturbance caused by [Root.GetName]'s development disrupted their natural lifecycle, causing them to react to the foreign substances we introduced into their ecosystem.

Given more time, our science team is confident that we can find a way to work in harmony with these lifeforms, integrating their unique biology into [Root.GetName]'s production pipelines.

descriptions.zh:
通过广泛的研究，我们的科学家成功对§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的寄生微生物进行了基因定向设计。这种变异旨在使它们将我们的材料识别为对自然生态无害的添加物，从而使我们能够继续建设而不再遇到问题。

在将这些基因改造后的寄生虫引入行星生物圈后，它们已成功融入其中。

此外，通过重新利用微生物原有的分解效应，我们成功利用该物质的粘合特性，提升了行星的生产效率。
descriptions.en:
Through extensive research, our scientists have engineered a variant species of the parasitic microorganisms on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. This mutation is designed to recognize our own materials as harmless additions to their natural ecology, enabling us to resume construction with no further issue.

After introducing them into the planet's biosphere, our engineered parasites have successfully integrated with it.

Furthermore, by repurposing the microorganisms' original decomposition effects, we have managed to harness the substance's adhesive properties to boost our planet's production processes.

label.en: And what can they teach us?

descriptions.zh:
我们正在为§Y[Root.GetName]§!上未来的扩张做土地整备时，一座巨大的结构仿佛在一瞬间凭空出现

这座结构释放着极不稳定的能量波，使其形态若隐若现，因此我们在该区域的初步扫描时没有发现这座建筑。

当它显现时，可以看到其密封的外墙装饰着某种难以理解的符号，而我们的记录中没有任何一种语言与之相符。

其功能尚未明确。该建筑目前为止还没有造成任何伤害，但确乎影响了我们的发展工作。
descriptions.en:
As we were preparing land for future expansion on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, a large structure seemingly blinked into existence.

The structure is emitting highly unstable energy waves causing it to intermittently appear and disappear from view. This explains why it was not present in initial scans of this sector.

When visible, unintelligible symbols adorn its sealed exterior, but match no known language in our records. 

No apparent function can be discerned. The construct has thus far caused no harm but it is obstructing our development efforts.

descriptions.zh:
我们对§Y[Root.GetName]§!上这座闪烁的建筑进行分析后，确信该物体会以某种方式扭曲光线。

在下方的硅酸盐地幔中发现了异常的地热活动。这种强大的能源为这座茕茕孑立的建筑提供动力，但其能量水平有很大的波动。

即便我对该建筑性质的理解正在逐渐加深，但仍未能进入其中——假设确实的能进去的话。

其密封外墙是由某种不明高反应性物质构成。尝试强制进入建筑只会导致其电磁场进一步失稳。我们可以尝试强制切开通道以进入研究，但不可预测的失稳风险非常巨大。
descriptions.en:
Analysis of the shimmering building on §Y[Root.GetName]§! leads us to assume the object is bending or distorting light somehow.

Exceptional geothermal activity has been detected in the silicate mantle below. This potent energy source powers the isolated structure, but its levels are fluctuating wildly.

While our understanding of the building's properties has grown, we have thus far been unable to enter it - if this is in fact even possible.

Its sealed exterior is comprised of unfamiliar and highly-reactive materials. Initial attempts to force entry into the structure only destabilized the building's electromagnetic fields further. We could cut our way in to learn more, but there is considerable risk of unpredictable destabilization.

descriptions.zh:
我们对§Y[Root.GetName]§!上这座闪烁的建筑进行分析后，确信该物体具有间歇性的隐形能力。

在下方的硅酸盐地幔中发现了异常的地热活动。这种强大的能源为这座茕茕孑立的建筑提供动力，但其能量水平有很大的波动。

descriptions.en:
Analysis of the shimmering building on §Y[Root.GetName]§! leads us to assume the object is somehow producing an intermittent cloaking effect.

Exceptional geothermal activity has been detected in the silicate mantle below. This potent energy source powers the isolated structure, but its levels are fluctuating wildly.

While our understanding of the building's cloaking effects has grown, we have thus far been unable to enter it - if this is in fact even possible.

Its sealed exterior is comprised of unfamiliar and highly-reactive materials. Initial attempts to force entry into the structure only destabilized the building's electromagnetic fields further. We could cut our way in to learn more, but there is considerable risk of unpredictable destabilization.

descriptions.zh:
尝试以暴力方式进入§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的建筑招致了一场灾难。我们的设备进一步让建筑的能量模式失稳，引发了一系列剧烈的爆炸。如今它只剩下一堆灰烬。

其意外的毁灭进一步招致出人意料的结果。附近的山谷里出现了一座被遗弃已久的外星人定居点废墟。

似乎这个物体以某种方式在前殖民地投射了一个强大的隐形场；至于是为了躲避什么仍然是个谜，但可以肯定，不管他们做过何种努力，如今都已是死寂一片。没有一件有考古价值的东西完好无损。

这种不寻常的技术的确切工作原理对我们来说仍然是未解之谜，但我们从这次经历中得到了些许新知识。我们将重新利用这种强大的地热能源为自己的殖民地服务。
descriptions.en:
Attempts to force entry into the structure on §Y[Root.GetName]§! ended in disaster. Our equipment further destabilized the building's energy patterns, causing a series of potent explosions. It is now little more than an ashen wreck.

Its accidental destruction produced an unexpected outcome. The razed ruins of a long-abandoned alien settlement appeared in a nearby valley.

It seems the object was somehow projecting a powerful cloaking field on the former colony; what they were hiding from remains a mystery, but what is certain is that they perished regardless of their efforts. Nothing of archaeological value remains intact.

The exact workings of this unusual technology remain unknown to us, but we gleaned some new knowledge from the experience. We will repurpose this potent geothermal energy source for our own colony.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[Root.GetName]§!上外形建筑外部的怪异文字进行的研究表明它其实是某种交互界面。我们利用它打开了一扇通向其空荡荡内部的隐藏门，一间宽敞的控制室出现在眼前。

尽管不了解其深层的工作原理，但我们通过试错法对它的命令有了基本的了解。中断它的功能时出现了一个意想不到的结果；在附近的山谷里出现了一处被遗弃已久的外星人定居点的废墟。

似乎这个物体以某种方式在前殖民地投射了一个强大的隐形场；至于是为了躲避什么仍然是个谜，但可以肯定，不管他们做过何种努力，如今都已是死寂一片。没有一件有考古价值的东西完好无损，但至少我们的科学家已经彻底掌握了这个控制室。

现在我们可以将这座建筑奇怪的隐形场稳定化并且扩展到整座山谷了。这可以大幅提升我们殖民地的安全系数。
descriptions.en:
Further study of the strange markings on the exterior of the alien structure on §Y[Root.GetName]§! revealed them to be an interface of sorts. We were able to manipulate them to open a hidden door into the building's deserted interior, revealing a vast control chamber.

Although ignorant of its deeper workings, we gained basic understanding over the commands using trial and error. Interrupting its functions produced an unexpected outcome; the derelict ruins of a long-abandoned alien settlement appeared in a nearby valley.

It seems the object was somehow projecting a powerful cloaking field on the former colony; what they were hiding from remains a mystery, but what is certain is they perished regardless of their efforts. While nothing of archaeological value remains intact, our scientists have made excellent use of the control chamber.

We are now able to stabilize and expand the building's strange cloaking effect to cover the entire valley. It will be a great enhancement to our colony's safety.

Although ignorant of its deeper workings, we gained basic understanding over the commands using trial and error. Interrupting its functions produced an unexpected outcome; the derelict ruins of a long-abandoned alien settlement appeared in a nearby valley.

We are now able to stabilize and expand the building's cloaking field to protect the entire valley, and have greatly increased our knowledge of cloaking technologies.

descriptions.zh:
大量巨型食草物种开始干扰§Y[Root.GetName]§!的能量产出。这些生物展现出大规模戏剧化的自杀式行为，活生生地在我们的发电站里电死烤焦。

这些动物有非常强烈的冲动，为了实现目标甚至冲破了我们电网周围的栅栏。由于这种奇特的行为，能源生产受到了影响。

然而这也带来了意料之外的食物产出，当地[Owner.GetColonistPlural]发现这种生物的肉非常地美味。

这一物种在该行星的生态系统中扮演了重要的角色。如果事故以当前频率发生下去，它们很快就会将自己灭绝的。
descriptions.en:
An abundant species of herbivorous megafauna have begun to disrupt the energy production of §Y[Root.GetName]§!. In dramatic displays of mass suicide, they are frying themselves alive on our power stations.

The animals are extremely driven in their purpose, breaking through fences around our energy grids to reach their goal. Energy generation is suffering as a result of this peculiar behavior.

This has however led to the unexpected benefit of increased food production, with [Owner.GetColonistPlural] discovering that the flesh of the creatures is highly delicious.

The species plays a pivotal role in the ecosystem of the planet. At the current rate of these incidents they will drive themselves to extinction.

descriptions.zh:
关于§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的物种自杀我们获得了极具价值的洞见。

这些巨型动物是功能性失明的，它们利用回声定位来观察和识别彼此。我们怀疑电网发出的频率超过了他们敏锐听觉所能忍受的程度，引发了对我们发电站的攻击行为。

除此之外，我们还了解到它们独特的消化酶可以作为冶金冶炼的催化剂。初步试验表明合金产量有望提高。

尽管有了这些发现，我们距离恢复正常的能源生产还有很长的路要走。我们的科学家将继续调查这个问题。
descriptions.en:
We have gained valuable insights on the suicidal fauna species on §Y[Root.GetName]§!.

These megafauna are functionally blind, using echolocation to see and identify one another. We suspect that our energy grids are emitting a frequency that is overwhelming their acute hearing, triggering this aggressive behavior toward our power stations.

In addition to this, we have learned that their unique digestive enzymes can act as a catalyst in metallurgic refining. Initial tests show potential in improving our alloy production.

Despite these discoveries, we are still a long way off from resuming normal energy production. Our scientists continue to investigate the issue.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经辨明了[Root.GetName]上的生物产生自杀式攻击冲动的原因。

对其回声定位系统和社会行为的进一步研究调查揭示了一个令人震惊的事实：他们的求偶呼叫和我们电网发出的噪音几乎处于完全一致的频率。

我们可以利用这些知识很方便地引导这些生物到特定的捕获装置中。饱餐一顿吧。
descriptions.en:
We have identified the cause of the aggressive suicidal impulses of the creatures on [Root.GetName].

Further observational study of their echolocation and social behaviors have revealed the shocking truth; their mating calls share an almost identical frequency to the sounds generated by our energy grids.

Conveniently, we can use this knowledge to channel the creatures into specialized harvesters. Let us feast.

我们可以复制这些巨兽的叫声，将它们的迁徙路线引导向远离我们殖民地的方向，稳定其种群数量。如此我们便能从它们的遗弃物中收获催化酶来促进我们的合金产出，同时继续研究它们独特的生理学。

在另一方面，

这些生物成了§Y[Root.GetName]§!的主食之一。

我们很容易制造特化的带电捕捉装置高效地处理这些动物而无需干扰能量产出。

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetColonistPlural]汇报了关于§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的沙子的奇特现象。

本该是风和日丽的一天我们定居点附近却唐突刮起剧烈的沙尘暴。如洪水般的流沙凭空出现又霎时消失无踪。甚至还有人在风平浪静的一天看到沙丘在横向移动。

这些事件至今没有找到任何气象或地理学的解释。

这些怪异的沙子没有造成直接的伤害，但妨碍到了我们殖民地的运作。对这一独特自然现象的研究仍在进行当中。
descriptions.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] are reporting strange phenomena with the sands on §Y[Root.GetName]§!.

Severe sandstorms materialize abruptly in close proximity to our colony on otherwise calm days. Rivers of fast-moving sand appear from nowhere before stopping as suddenly as they began. There are even reports of sand dunes moving laterally on a perfectly windless day.

No atmospheric or geological explanations for these events have thus far been identified.

These peculiar sands are causing us no direct harm, but they are interfering with our colony's operations. The study of this unique phenomenon is ongoing.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的沙暴开始发出低沉的轰鸣声。这种声音会经常改变音调，并呈现出一定的重复模式。

尽管这种“歌唱沙”的现象可以归咎于自由颗粒的已知特性，但这种变调之频繁却无法单单使用摩擦力来解释。

我们还找到一座被沙丘掩埋的山谷，其中满满刻蚀着奇特的符号。这些图样的阵列会短暂地突出浮现，又几乎瞬间消失得无影无踪。

让沙子活动起来的原因尚不明确，但这些模式的一致性表明了其行为背后应该存在某种目的或意图。
descriptions.en:
The sandstorms on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have started emitting a deep droning sound. The frequency regularly shifts in pitch and modulates in recurring patterns.

While this 'singing sand' phenomenon can be attributed to known properties of free particles, the regularity of these modulations cannot be explained by friction alone.

We have also found a valley filled with dunes etched with strange symbols. These glyphs appear fleetingly in raised formations before dispersing almost instantaneously.

What is animating the sand is unclear, but the consistent nature of the patterns suggest purpose or intent behind its behavior.

descriptions.zh: 研究§Y[Root.GetName]§!上沙暴的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现，分布在硅酸盐中的物质是泽珞。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] studying the sandstorms on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have discovered that Zro is distributed throughout the silicate material.

descriptions.zh: 研究§Y[Root.GetName]§!上沙暴的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现了一种分布在硅酸盐中的全新独特物质。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] studying the sandstorms on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have discovered that a new form of exotic matter is distributed throughout the silicate material.

descriptions.zh: [Owner.GetResearchers]在处理样品时出现了短暂但强烈的灵能视，看见了泽珞族形象的幻象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上。
descriptions.en: While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced brief but powerful psionic visions. They witnessed apparitions of Zroni figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

descriptions.zh: [Owner.GetResearchers]在处理样品时出现了短暂但强烈的灵能视，看见了未知外形种族的幻象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上。
descriptions.en: While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced brief but powerful psionic visions. They witnessed apparitions of unfamiliar alien figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

descriptions.en: While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced brief but powerful visions. They witnessed apparitions of Zroni figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

descriptions.en: While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced brief but powerful visions. They witnessed apparitions of unfamiliar alien figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetResearchers]在处理样品时内电路受到了干扰。

这些强烈的干扰导致了视觉处理异常，产生一种泽珞族形象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上的幻象。
descriptions.en:
While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced interference with their internal circuitry.

These powerful disruptions caused malfunctions in visual processing, resulting in the apparition of Zroni figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetResearchers]在处理样品时内电路受到了干扰。

这些强烈的干扰导致了视觉处理异常，产生一种未知外星种族形象游荡在这颗行星布满咒文的沙丘上的幻象。
descriptions.en:
While handling the samples, [Owner.GetResearchers] experienced interference with their internal circuitry.

These powerful disruptions caused malfunctions in visual processing, resulting in the apparition of unfamiliar alien figures roaming the planet's glyphed dunes.

descriptions.zh:
这些幻象似乎是符文的来源。符号的解码还需要花上一些时间，但我们相信它一定是某种形式的书面语言。

我们很容易就能从沙子中提取泽珞，但这可能就会导致幻象消散。尽管如此，这种宝贵物质的数量还是相当庞大的。
descriptions.en:
These apparitions appear to be the source of the glyphs. Decoding the symbols is time-consuming, but we believe that it is clearly some form of written language.

We could simply extract the Zro from the sand, but doing so will likely cause the apparitions to dissipate. However, there is quite a large amount of the valuable substance.

descriptions.zh:
这些幻象似乎是符文的来源。符号的解码还需要花上一些时间，但我们相信它一定是某种形式的书面语言。

我们很容易就能从沙子中提取这种奇特物质，但这可能就会导致幻象消散。尽管如此，这种违背物理现象的物质可能会极具价值。
descriptions.en:
These apparitions appear to be the source of the glyphs. Decoding the symbols is time-consuming, but we believe that it is clearly some form of written language.

We could simply extract the exotic material from the sand, but doing so could cause the apparitions to dissipate. However, this unique physics-defying substance may prove to be highly valuable.

descriptions.zh: 利用对泽珞族文化已有的知识，我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的沙子上标记了一个新的符文；泽珞语的你好。我们立刻就得到了回应。
descriptions.en: We used our previous knowledge of Zroni culture to mark a new glyph upon the sands on §Y[Root.GetName]§!; the symbol for a Zroni greeting. The response came immediately.

descriptions.zh: 使用我们的语言库，我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的沙子上书写了所有已知外星文字的数百种代表问候的符号。终于，我们得到了一个回复。
descriptions.en: Using our language databases, we marked hundreds of symbols representing greetings in every known alien script upon the sands on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. Eventually, a response came.

descriptions.zh:
沙暴消散、洪水平息，沙丘的歌也归于沉寂。整座沙丘升入空中，逐渐塑成了新的形体。活动的沙子在空中形成飞旋的人形，形成了复杂的奇景。

我们立刻就发现了这是个泽珞族的故事；一种全新力量和可怕冲突的幻象。这些沙子由内含的泽珞驱动，形成了远古泽珞种族的宇宙回响。

之后，灵能沙子再度平息。沙暴再也没有出现，我们只能理解为这些沙子对我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的存在更加习惯了。
descriptions.en:
The sandstorms dissipated, the valley floor settled, and the dune song went silent. Entire sand dunes then lifted into the air, taking on new forms in the process. Figures formed from animated sand swirled in an intricate airborne spectacle.

We immediately recognized this as a story of the Zroni; a vision of newfound power and terrible conflict. Animated by the Zro within, these sands formed a cosmic echo of the ancient Zroni race.

Afterwards, the psionic sands settled once again. The storms have not returned; we can only believe that these sands have become more amenable to our presence on §Y[Root.GetName]§! .

descriptions.zh:
沙暴消散、洪水平息，沙丘的歌也归于沉寂。整座沙丘升入空中，逐渐塑成了新的形体。活动的沙子在空中形成飞旋的人形，形成了复杂的奇景。

我们立刻就发现了这就是泽珞族的故事；他们飞升入虚境又招致毁灭。这些沙子由内含的泽珞驱动，形成了泽珞族悲剧命运的宇宙回响。

之后，灵能沙子再度平息。沙暴再也没有出现，我们只能理解为这些沙子对我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的存在更加习惯了。
descriptions.en:
The sandstorms dissipated, the valley floor settled, and the dune song went silent. Entire sand dunes then lifted into the air, taking on new forms in the process. Figures formed from animated sand swirled in an intricate airborne spectacle.

We immediately recognized this as the story of the Zroni; their ascent into the Shroud and ensuing destruction. Animated by the Zro within, these sands formed a cosmic echo of Zroni's tragic fate.

Afterwards, the psionic sands settled once again. The storms have not returned; we can only believe that these sands have become more amenable to our presence on §Y[Root.GetName]§! .

descriptions.zh:
沙暴消散、洪水平息，沙丘的歌也归于沉寂。整座沙丘升入空中，逐渐塑成了新的形体。活动的沙子在空中形成飞旋的人形，形成了复杂的奇景。

我们唯一了解到的是这是某个外星种族发现新力量并招致分裂和毁灭的故事。

之后，灵能沙子再度平息。沙暴再也没有出现，我们只能理解为这些沙子对我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的存在更加习惯了。
descriptions.en:
The sandstorms dissipated, the valley floor settled, and the dune song went silent. Entire sand dunes then lifted into the air, taking on new forms in the process. Figures formed from animated sand swirled in an intricate airborne spectacle.

We understood only that this was a story of an alien race discovering a newfound power that eventually divided and destroyed them.

Afterwards, the psionic sands settled once again. The storms have not returned; we can only believe that these sands have become more amenable to our presence on §Y[Root.GetName]§! .

descriptions.zh:
利用泽珞蒸馏的专业技术，我们从§Y[Root.GetName]§!的沙子里提取了大量的泽珞，并且在过程中学习到了很多。

清理掉泽珞污染物之后，这些沙子的行为变得正常了起来。我们的殖民地不用再受到不可预测的沙暴现象袭扰。无论之前是什么东西在操控这些沙子，它们都已经消失在了虚空中。
descriptions.en:
Using our expertise in Zro Distillation, we extracted a sizable quantity from the sands on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, learning a great deal in the process.

With the Zro contamination removed, the sands here appear to be normalized. Our colony is no longer encountering the unpredictable sandstorm phenomena. Whatever was previously manipulating these sands is now lost to the ether.

descriptions.zh:
关于在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上采收泽珞的工作好坏参半。我们虽然成功提取了一小部分，但大多数都在实验过程中损失了。然而我们也确实在这个过程中学到了许多。

清理掉泽珞污染物之后，这些沙子的行为变得正常了起来。我们的殖民地不用再受到不可预测的沙暴现象袭扰。无论之前是什么东西在操控这些沙子，它们都已经消失在了虚空中。
descriptions.en:
Efforts to harvest the Zro on §Y[Root.GetName]§! produced mixed results. We successfully extracted a small quantity, but much was lost in the course of our experiments. We did however learn a great deal in the process.

With the Zro contamination removed, the sands here appear to be normalized. Our colony is no longer encountering the unpredictable sandstorm phenomena. Whatever was previously manipulating these sands is now lost to the ether.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的一位[Owner.GetExplorer]突然失去了联系，此前他刚刚汇报过在一处此前未测绘的山谷里发现了潜在的§Y异星天然气§!。
descriptions.en: Communications were lost with one of our [Owner.GetExplorer] on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, shortly after they reported a potential §YExotic Gas§! discovery in a previously unmapped valley.

descriptions.zh: 在这个节点完全静默之前，我们感受到了一阵短暂的剧痛。
descriptions.en: We sensed a brief but agonizing pain before the nodes fell silent.

descriptions.zh: 该节点的数据在失联下线前遭到了严重破坏。现在已经完全与我们的网络断开连接。
descriptions.en: The nodes' data became corrupted before going offline. They are no longer connected to our network.

descriptions.zh: 令人担忧的是，他最后的通讯是在某种类似惨叫一样的声音后突然切断的。我们做了最坏的打算。
descriptions.en: Worryingly, their final transmission cut off abruptly with what sounded like anguished cries. We fear the worst.

descriptions.zh:
在调查§Y[Root.GetName]§!上失联的[Owner.GetExplorer]最后的已知地点时，我们发现了一大片正在冒出纯§Y异星天然气§!薄雾的强酸性泥潭。这片沼泽生长着一种强韧的本地植物，能够耐受这种极端的酸性。

尽管这片区域极度危险，对这片气雾进行进一步研究或许会对殖民地资源产出大有裨益。
descriptions.en:
While investigating the last known location of the missing [Owner.GetExplorer] on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, we discovered a landscape of highly acidic bogs exuding a mist of pure §YExotic Gas§!. These swamps are home to a species of resilient native flora that is capable of surviving the extreme acidity.

While the landscape is highly hazardous, conducting further research into the gas mists could prove beneficial for colony resources.

descriptions.zh:
在研究§Y[Root.GetName]§!的酸性沼泽时，我们的一位[Owner.GetScientistPlural]及其研究设备被当地植物的卷须缠住，并被拖进了一个极具腐蚀性的泥潭中。他几乎在一瞬间就溶解了，我们相信失踪的[Owner.GetExplorer]可能也遭受到了相似的命运。

很快，这株植物的卷须肉眼可见地膨胀，并且释放出了少量的§Y异星天然气§!。这种掠食性植物似乎将酸性沼泽作为外消化系统；通过捕猎卷须把猎物拖进去溶解，然后吸收营养。这一过程中会释放少量的异星天然气供收获。

我们推测，可以利用这种植物的生物学特性，通过喂它殖民地的废弃物来产生更多的天然气以供利用。或者我们可以中和这些酸性沼泽，重新开垦营养丰富的土地用于农业。
descriptions.en:
While studying the acidic swamps on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, one of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] and their observation equipment were ensnared by the tendrils of the native flora before being dragged into a highly caustic pool. They dissolved nearly instantly. We believe a similar fate befell the missing [Owner.GetExplorer].

Soon after, the plant's tendrils visibly inflated and traces of §YExotic Gas§! spiked. It appears this predatory flora uses the acidic bogs as an external digestive system; dragging prey in via hunter tendrils to be dissolved and then absorbing the nutrients. This process releases a small quantity of harvestable Exotic Gas in the process.

We speculate that this organism's biology could be exploited by feeding it colony waste in order to produce more gases. Alternatively, we could neutralize these acidic bogs to reclaim the nutrient-rich lands for agriculture.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!成功中和了酸性沼泽，同时消灭了生存其中的植物物种。因此，§Y异星天然气§!雾也消失了。

这些开垦后的土地由于原生植物的养分残留而异常肥沃，我们创造了额外的宝贵农业用地。
descriptions.en:
We succeeded in neutralizing the acidic bogs on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, simultaneously killing off the flora species which lived in them. The §YExotic Gas§! mists have disappeared as a result.

These reclaimed lands are unusually fertile, owing to the leftover nutrients from the native flora's feeding process. We have created additional valuable agricultural space.

label.zh: 很好，把剩余物也收割了吧。

descriptions.zh:
此前被认为休眠已久的§Y[Root.GetName]§!地热喷泉剧烈喷发，向大气层喷射出含有§Y暗物质§!的气体。

此次喷发遮天蔽日，导致了严重的引力异常，阻碍了星际旅行和通讯。

我们认为暗物质可能源于该行星独特的核心。这种极端的环境对我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]构成了威胁，因此我们已经部署了轨道虹吸装置用于从平流层提取这种瘴气。
descriptions.en:
What was previously thought to be a long dormant geyser on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has violently erupted, spewing §YDark Matter§! infused gas into the atmosphere.

The eruption has saturated the skies, leading to severe gravitational anomalies that are blocking offworld travel and communications.

We believe the dark matter somehow originates from the planet's unique core. Orbital siphons have been deployed to extract the miasma from the stratosphere, as the extreme conditions pose a danger to our [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

descriptions.zh: 我们已成功地从§Y[Root.GetName]§!的大气中抽取了§Y暗物质§!瘴气，并开始评估损害。
descriptions.en: We have successfully siphoned the §YDark Matter§! miasma from the atmosphere of §Y[Root.GetName]§!, and are beginning to assess the damage.

descriptions.zh: 与殖民地重新取得联系后，我们发现[Owner.GetColonistPlural]已被某种似乎是固化的暗物质石化。在这些空壳内探测到生命迹象后，我们小心地将其提取了出来。
descriptions.en: When re-establishing contact with the colony we discovered the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] had been petrified by what appears to be solidified dark matter. Detecting life signs within these husks, we carefully extracted them.

descriptions.zh: 与殖民地重新取得联系后，我们发现[Owner.GetColonistPlural]已被某种似乎是固化的暗物质石化。从残骸内部检测到功能性电子信号后，我们将其释放了出来。
descriptions.en: When re-establishing contact with the colony we discovered the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] had been petrified by what appears to be solidified dark matter. Detecting functional electronic signals from within the husks, we broke them free.

descriptions.zh: 与殖民地重新取得联系后，我们发现[Owner.GetColonistPlural]已被某种似乎是固化的暗物质石化。察觉到他们试图重新融入集体，我们便将他们从物理坟墓中解救出来。
descriptions.en: When re-establishing contact with the colony we discovered the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] had been petrified by what appears to be solidified dark matter. Sensing their attempts to reintegrate back into the collective, we broke them free of their physical tomb.

descriptions.zh:
与所有预期相反，[Owner.GetColonistPlural]似乎并未受到长时间暴露和静止状态的影响。

造成最初事件的间歇喷泉现已坍塌成一个暗物质液态湖。

这是一个前所未有的事件，需要集中研究。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]不确定该如何分配他们本已捉襟见肘的资源。
descriptions.en:
Contrary to all expectations, the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] seem unaffected by their prolonged exposure and stasis.

The geyser responsible for the original incident has since collapsed into a lake of liquid dark matter.

This is an unprecedented event that requires concentrated study. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are unsure where to focus their already-stretched resources.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，位于§Y[Root.GetName]§!的§Y暗物质§!湖泊对行星的进一步威胁微乎其微。但人口正在出现的症状却并非如此。

在研究隔离的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]期间，我们发现他们被该物质包裹后，身体在发生持续的变化。
descriptions.en:
Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are confident that the lake of §YDark Matter§! on §Y[Root.GetName]§! presents minimal further danger to the planet. The same can not be said for the emerging symptoms affecting the population.

While studying the quarantined [Owner.GetColonistPlural], we have identified ongoing physical changes resulting from their entombment in the substance.

descriptions.zh: 长时间的暴露使他们体内的分子充满了暗物质，完全破坏了他们的系统。
descriptions.en: The prolonged exposure saturated the molecules in their bodies with dark matter, corrupting their systems completely.

descriptions.zh: 长时间的暴露使他们体内的分子充满了暗物质，污染了他们的循环系统。
descriptions.en: The prolonged exposure saturated the molecules in their bodies with dark matter, contaminating their circulatory systems.

descriptions.zh: 虽然这些污染物确实存在引发系统过早失效的风险，但如果将其整合到组装过程中，它们将使在这个星球上建造的装置能够高效地处理和采集暗物质作为子程序。
descriptions.en: While these contaminants do run the risk of triggering premature system failure, they will allow units constructed on this world to efficiently process and harvest Dark Matter as a subroutine if integrated into their assembly processes.

descriptions.zh: 我们可以培养这些异常现象，使我们身体的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]能够加工和分泌可收集的暗物质，代价是缩短他们的寿命。
descriptions.en: We can cultivate these abnormalities, allowing the bodies of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to process and secrete harvestable Dark Matter, at the expense of shortening their life expectancy.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的暗物质湖的进一步研究揭示了关键的地质信息，这可能解释了最初事件的原因。

该行星的核心存在一个微型黑洞，尺寸不到一米。行星本身更大的质量抵消了我们本应从这种异常现象中探测到的预期引力。这种质量之间的关系似乎达到了微妙的平衡，应该会持续相当长的时间。

最近的地震活动导致内层地幔发生位移，从而引发了最初的间歇泉喷发。暗物质湖本身起到了稳定行星核心并防止进一步爆发的作用。

然而，长期饱和的暗物质并非最初看起来那么无害。

在[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的质心处形成了不稳定的微型黑洞，导致它们的躯体剧烈内爆。剩下的只是一具由结晶暗物质构成的无生命外壳。扫描未检测到内部有任何进一步的活动迹象。

我们的最终统计显示，§Y[Root.GetName]§!的居民在一瞬间损失了大约四分之一。取而代之的是，各种姿势的固态暗物质雕像散落在行星上。
descriptions.en:
Further study of the dark matter lake on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has revealed crucial geological information that may explain the cause of the initial incident.

The planet's core is host to a micro black hole, less than a meter in length. The greater mass of the planet itself nullifies the expected gravitational forces we would have detected from such an anomaly. It appears this relationship between the masses has reached a delicate equilibrium that should remain for quite some time.

Recent seismic activity led to a displacement in the inner mantle, causing the initial geyser eruption. The dark matter lake itself acted as a plug to stabilize the planet's core and prevent further outbursts.

However, the long term saturation in dark matter was not as harmless as it initially appeared.

Unstable micro black holes formed in the center of mass of the [Owner.GetColonistPlural], causing their bodies to violently implode. All that remained was a lifeless husk made of crystallized dark matter. Scans detected no signs of further activity inside.

Our final count shows we have lost approximately a quarter of §Y[Root.GetName]§!'s population in an instant. In their place, statues of solid dark matter litter the planet in various poses.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!发现了一种极为恶心的本土生物。

它们进化出了一种防御机制，同时也成为了它们获取食物的主要方式。由于缺乏自身分解固体食物所需的消化酶，它们会释放出一种强烈且令人作呕的气体，当其他具有正常消化系统的生物吸入时，会引发剧烈呕吐。这些被排出的物质随后被它们作为主要的营养来源。

清除这些令人厌恶的生物将为我们带来丰厚的§Y异星天然气§!和§Y食物§!资源。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered a notably disgusting species of fauna native to §Y[Root.GetName]§!.

They have evolved a defense mechanism that happens to also serve as their primary method of food acquisition. Lacking the digestive enzymes needed to break down solid food on their own, they emit a powerful and repulsive gas that induces projectile vomiting when inhaled by other organisms with a functioning gut. These ejected substances are then consumed as their main source of nutrients.

The culling of these foul creatures will provide a useful windfall of §YExotic Gas§! and §YFood§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]遇到了一种本土的动物物种，它们拥有一种相当……独特的获取食物的方式。

尽管最初这些生物较为害羞，但它们已经逐渐习惯了我们的存在，并且由于其友好的天性，甚至在一些较为幼稚的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]中颇受欢迎。

虽然它们不构成直接威胁，但它们进化出了一种防御机制，这种机制恰好也是它们获取食物的主要方式。由于缺乏自身分解固体食物所需的消化酶，它们会释放出一种强烈且令人作呕的气体，当被其他具有正常消化系统的生物吸入时，会引发剧烈的呕吐。这些被排出的物质随后被它们作为主要的营养来源。

总的来说，这一情况存在传染病蔓延的风险，当地领导人一直在敦促[Owner.GetColonistPlural]远离这些奇怪的生物。
descriptions.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have encountered a species of fauna native to the planet with a rather... unique method of gathering its food.

Though initially shy, these creatures have since become accustomed to our presence, and with their friendly nature are even proving popular among the more immature [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

While posing no direct danger, they have evolved a defense mechanism that happens to also serve as their primary method of food acquisition. Lacking the digestive enzymes needed to break down solid food on their own, they emit a powerful and repulsive gas that induces projectile vomiting when inhaled by other organisms with a functioning gut. These ejected substances are then consumed as their main source of nutrients.

The overall situation has a risk of spreading infectious diseases, and local leaders have been urging [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to steer clear of the strange things.

label.zh: 多么奇葩的异种生物学知识。

descriptions.zh:
清除§Y[Root.GetName]§!上令人作呕的害虫已被证明十分困难。尽管官方已发出警告，但殖民地中较为年轻的成员仍然继续与这些动物玩耍。

由于这个原因，我们的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]蛋白质已经成为它们首选的食物来源。与行星上其他知道躲避它们恶臭气体的动物相比，我们的殖民地已经变得更容易被攻击。这些生物已经进一步适应了我们的存在，并且有人目击到它们对任何饭后独自游荡的[Owner.GetColonist]采取伏击战术。

令人难以置信的是，这种情况也有一些好处。我们的科学家发现，这些生物排放的催吐气体中含有宝贵的§Y异星天然气§!粒子，可以通过驯养这些野兽并将它们圈养在隔离设施中来收集。

然而，大多数殖民者都提议我们直接根除它们。
descriptions.en:
Ridding §Y[Root.GetName]§! of its revolting pests has proven difficult. Younger members of the colony continue to play with the animals despite official warnings.

As a result of this, our [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName] proteins have become their preferred source of food. Our colony has become a much easier target than the rest of the planetary fauna who know to avoid their foul gases. These creatures have adapted further to our presence, and have been witnessed employing ambush tactics against any lone [Owner.GetColonist] wandering around after a meal.

Unbelievably, there are some benefits to this situation. Our scientists have discovered the emetic fumes emitted by the creatures contain valuable §YExotic Gas§! particles which could be harvested by domesticating the beasts and keeping them in quarantined facilities.

The majority of the colony, however, have proposed that we simply eradicate them.

label.en: Enough is enough. Shoot them on sight.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的生物不再引发大规模呕吐现象。

随着针对其异种生物学构造的合成营养膏的研发，我们已调节了它们的饮食周期，彻底根除了它们对我们[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的偷袭。

我们已将它们迁移至一个精心设计的野生动物保护区，公众可以在安全的环境中观赏这些动物。专业饲养员已接受培训，能够在不造成进一步伤害的情况下提取它们的§Y异星天然气§!。
descriptions.en:
The creatures on §Y[Root.GetName]§! are no longer causing mass regurgitations.

With the development of a synthetic nutrient paste catered to their xenobiology, we have regulated their dietary cycles and put an end to their opportunistic ambushes on our [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

We have relocated them to a carefully designed wildlife reserve where the public can enjoy the animals in a safe environment. Specialist handlers have been trained to extract their §YExotic Gas §!without further harm.

label.zh: 确保我们不会发展出那种气味。
label.en: Ensure that we don't evolve that smell.

descriptions.zh:
自从采纳官方的“就地射杀”政策以来，已经过去几个月了，再也没有人在§Y[Root.GetName]§!殖民地附近发现过那些惹人厌的物种。

虽然有些[Owner.GetColonistPlural]怀念这些毛茸茸的生物，但现在每个人都更快乐了，因为他们可以自由行动，不必再担心被强制呕吐。

我们的科学家已经收集了这些动物的尸体，直接从它们的内脏中提取了一些§Y异星天然气§!。
descriptions.en:
Since adopting an official shoot on sight policy, it has now been several months since the offending species on §Y[Root.GetName]§! was last sighted near the colony.

While some [Owner.GetColonistPlural] miss the presence of the furry creatures, everyone is happier overall now that they can travel freely without fear of forcibly regurgitating.

Our scientists have harvested the bodies of the animals, extracting some amount of §YExotic Gas§! directly from their internal organs.

label.zh: 确保我们不会发展出那种气味。
label.en: Ensure that we don't evolve that smell.

descriptions.zh:
来自§Y[Root.GetName]§!的报告显示，农村与城市人口之间出现了令人担忧的地区间敌对情绪。除了他们所处的地理位置外，目前尚未发现引发这种敌意的明显原因。

新移民最初会遭到敌视，但在被分配到各自的地区几周后，他们很快就会被接纳。基于此，我们的科学家确信，这种异常行为是由地区内的局部因素驱动的。

在我们调查此事的同时，我们需要稳定局势，以防止进一步升级。我们可以选择正式支持农村或城市地区，或者部署额外的执法力量以维持和平。
descriptions.en:
Reports from §Y[Root.GetName]§! show an alarming emergence of interdistrict hostility between the rural and urban populations. There is no discernible cause that has triggered this animosity other than their arbitrary geographical location.

New immigrants are initially treated with enmity, but within weeks of their assignment to their respective districts they are soon welcomed into the fold. Based on this, our scientists are convinced this strange behavior is being driven by factors localized to the districts.

While we investigate this matter, we need to stabilize the situation to prevent further escalation. We can choose to officially support either the rural or urban districts, or deploy additional enforcement to keep the peace.

descriptions.zh:
在对§Y[Root.GetName]§!进行了广泛的环境调查后，我们的科学家们已经确定了地域仇恨行为的根源。


在行星地幔深处，存在着一个巨型生物腐烂的尸体。经过数千年的分解，这具早已死亡的生物的脊髓液渗入了行星的地下水中，并催生了一种精神细菌。这种改变思维的微生物随后进入了我们[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的神经系统，诱发了强烈的领地意识，而这很可能是原始动物所具有的特性。
descriptions.en:
After extensive environmental surveys of §Y[Root.GetName]§!, our scientists have identified the cause of the interdistrict hostility.

Deep within the planetary mantle lies the decaying corpse of a giant organism. Following millennia of decomposition, spinal fluid from the long-dead creature seeped into the planet's groundwater, lacing it with a psionic bacteria. This mind-altering microbe subsequently entered the nervous systems of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] and induced strong territorial instincts that were likely properties of the original animal.

descriptions.zh: 这种外来杂质正在干扰我们的自然灵能力量。我们应该能够通过将供水系统经过一系列专门设计的高等级过滤器来解决这个问题。
descriptions.en: This exotic impurity is interfering with our natural psionic abilities.We should be able to address the issue by running the water supply through a complex series of uniquely-purposed high-grade filters.

descriptions.zh: 我们应该能够通过将供水系统经过一系列专门设计的高等级过滤器来解决这个问题。
descriptions.en: We should be able to address the issue by running the water supply through a complex series of uniquely-purposed high-grade filters.

descriptions.zh: 另外，我们的科学家确信可以在细胞水平上对这种细菌进行基因改造，将其领地性倾向引导至更具生产力的方向。
descriptions.en: Alternatively, our scientists are confident that the bacteria can be genetically modified at the cellular level, redirecting the territorial tendencies towards more productive ends.

label.zh: 尝试对细菌进行基因改造。
label.en: Attempt to genetically alter the bacteria.

descriptions.zh: 在§Y[Root.GetName]§!部署的净水站取得了显著成功。
descriptions.en: The deployment of water filtration stations on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been a resounding success.

descriptions.zh: 激烈的领土敌意行为已经消退，不仅对我们心灵感应能力的干扰已经结束，这些能力还通过天然益生菌得到了进一步增强，促进了§Y心灵突触§!在§Y[Root.GetName]§!个体之间的形成。这强化了我们共享的心灵传送连结，培养了更强烈的社区意识，同时提高了生产力。
descriptions.en: Hyper-territorial aggression has subsided, and not only has interference with our psionic capabilities ended, they have been further enhanced with natural probiotics that foster a §YPsionic Ephapse§! between individuals on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. This reinforces our shared telepathic connection and fosters an even greater sense of community while improving productivity.

descriptions.zh: 虽然激烈的领土敌意行为已经消退，但人群中留下了一些残余但可能有益的副作用，即天然益生菌，这些益生菌在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的个体之间促进了§Y灵能突触§!的形成。这使得我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]能够在心灵感应的层面上相互交流，增强了社区意识并提高了生产力。
descriptions.en: While the hyper-territorial aggression has subsided, the population has been left with some residual but potentially useful side-effects in the form of natural probiotics that foster a §YPsionic Ephapse§! between individuals on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. This allows our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to communicate with one other on a telepathic level, fostering a greater sense of community and improving productivity.

tooltips.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!上的所有人口都获得§Y灵能突触§!
我们的主体物种获得了§Y灵能突触§!

descriptions.zh:
我们已成功消除了细菌生物对§Y[Root.GetName]§!产生的负面影响。[Owner.GetColonistPlural]之间的内斗已经平息，并且他们已经表现出生产力提高的迹象。

我们的科学家们有信心能够进一步编辑该微生物的基因代码。通过正确地对它的基因组进行测序，我们可以进一步提升[Owner.GetColonistPlural]在某方面的表现。

然而，这种微生物在被运离星球后将无法存活。它的线粒体与外星生物尸体之间的灵能连接必须保持完整，细菌才能繁殖。我们尚未完全理解其中的原因。
descriptions.en:
We have successfully neutralized the negative effects of the bacterial organism on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. The infighting among the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] has subsided and they are already showing signs of elevated productivity.

Our scientists are confident that they can go even further in editing the microbe's genetic code. With the correct sequencing of its genome, we could further enhance one aspect of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural]' performance.

However, the resulting microorganism will not survive long when transported offworld. The psionic connection between its mitochondria and the alien carcass must remain intact in order for the bacteria to reproduce. We do not yet fully understand why.

descriptions.zh:
该设施的内部包含了无数被废弃的医疗机械、治疗舱室和一个太平间。太平间的储藏荚舱里发现有一些部分保存完好的有机遗骸有疾患和病变的迹象。安全门、监视设备和拘留室的存在让§H[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]§!得出结论，有些个体是被强行关押在这里的。

我们取回了一些设备部件，但绝大部分都腐坏严重。电脑系统中残存的数据有限，我们虽然恢复了一些文件但仍有待翻译。
descriptions.en:
The facility's interior contains a myriad of abandoned medical machines, treatment chambers, and a morgue. In the cadaver storage pods, we found partially-preserved organic remains with signs of disease and deformation. The presence of security doors, surveillance rigs, and holding cells has led §H[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]§! to conclude that some were kept here against their will.

We salvaged a few equipment parts but almost everything has decayed markedly. Limited data remained on the computer systems; we recovered some files but they require translation.

descriptions.zh:
§H[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]§!提交了一份从§Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§!的设施里恢复的数据资料的部分翻译。

§L17号实验室——进度汇报——研究主任吉列伯

新的原型展现出了一些初步的潜力。对象的免疫系统增强了数百万倍，而且所有的病原体都已被清除。副作用依旧存在：紧随其后的致命突变，无一幸免。会再做尝试。我很确信，万能巨噬细胞已经成功在望了。§!
descriptions.en:
§H[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]§! produced a partial translation for one of the data files recovered from the facility on §Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§!.

§LLab 17 - Progress update - Research Lead Gelebor

The new prototype showed initial promise. Subjects' immune systems boosted millionfold and all pathogens were eradicated. Side effects persisted: fatal mutations followed, no survivors. Will try again. The Universal Macrophage is within our reach, I am sure of it.§!

descriptions.zh:
§H[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]§!翻译了从§Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§!上的废弃实验室取回的另一份文件。

§L17号实验室——内部员工笔记——研究主任吉列伯

同事们，项目终止命令今天来了；宗主已经没耐心了。但我们离目标就只差一步！万能巨噬细胞比任何人的突发奇想都重要。我们可以拥有一个没有疾病的未来！为了取得这样的进步，多牺牲几个生命的代价又有多大呢？

如果他们不送来更多的实验对象——我就在我自己身上做实验。你们要和我一起吗？§!
descriptions.en:
§H[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]§! translated another file from the abandoned laboratory on §Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§!.

§LLab 17 - Internal staff memo - Research Lead Gelebor

Colleagues, the project termination order came today; the overlord's patience is at an end. And yet we are so close to our goal! The Universal Macrophage is more important than the whims of any one individual. A disease-free future can be ours! What is the small cost of a few more lives for such progress?

If they don't send more trial subjects - I will test the latest prototype on myself. Will you join me?§!

descriptions.zh:
§H[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]§!翻译了§Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§!上生物实验室的电脑里的最后一份日志。

§L17号实验室——最终汇报——科研助理菲力多

我们盲目地跟随着的就是这个吉列伯的自信。

在我们自己身上测试原型，免疫系统一开始得到了增强；我们几乎可以免疫一切外部病原体。然后突变就开始了。

吉列伯先死了。死状惨不忍睹。现在整个团队都躺在了在太平间里，我也很快就会加入他们。

我们失败了。我们把自己的性命托付给了吉列伯的错误配方。万能巨噬细胞功能过于强大——它最终会攻击宿主自身。这里的一切东西都必须销毁。§!
descriptions.en:
§H[universal_macrophage_scientist.GetName]§! translated the final log entry from the bio lab's computers on §Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§!.

§LLab 17 - Final Report - Research Assistant Filidor

Such was Gelebor's confidence that we followed him blindly.

Testing the prototype on ourselves, our immune systems were initially bolstered; we were nigh invincible to any outside pathogens. Then the mutations started.

Gelebor perished first. It was difficult to watch. Now the whole team is resting in the morgue and I will soon join them.

We failed. We trusted our lives to Gelebor's flawed formula. The Universal Macrophage works too well - it eventually attacks the host itself. Everything here must be destroyed.§!

label.zh: 继续完成吉列伯的工作，这看起来很有希望。
label.en: Complete Gelebor's work. It holds promise.

label.zh: 这种有缺陷的研究也是能堪一用的。
label.en: This flawed research can be put to use.

label.zh: 我们是突变的主宰。让我们完成这工作。
label.en: We are masters of Mutation. Let us finish the work.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的居民正在经历严重的身体突变，细胞和重要器官的功能遭到了破坏。虽然在某些情况下，这些变化提高了代谢效率，但更常见的结果是死亡。

这些副作用与§Y万能巨噬细胞§!原始研究笔记中描述的完全吻合。尽管我们做出了努力，但由配方引起的致命突变似乎是不可避免的。这项技术不能再被信任了。我们正在销毁所有剩余的配方并将停止使用。
descriptions.en:
Citizens on §Y[Root.GetName]§! are experiencing severe physical mutations that disrupt the functioning of cells and vital organs. While in some instances these changes have enhanced metabolic efficiency, more commonly they are causing fatalities.

These side effects are a perfect match with the ones described in the original research notes of the §YUniversal Macrophage§!. Despite our efforts, it appears that the fatal mutations caused by the formula are unavoidable. This technology can no longer be trusted. We are destroying all remaining supplies of the formula and will discontinue its usage.

descriptions.zh: 对在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的巨大神秘方块进行进一步调查反而带来了比答案更多的问题。它的外表面绝对光滑无缝，我们的扫描仪无法穿透。当我们靠近立方体时，它光洁壮观的立面突然轻轻泛起涟漪，响应着我们的出现。§H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§!得出结论，它是由某种形式的§Y活体金属§!建造而成的。
descriptions.en: Closer inspection of the giant mysterious cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName] has raised more questions than answers. Its outer surfaces are perfectly smooth, seamless, and impenetrable to our scanners. As we approached the cube, the imposing facade seemed to ripple gently in response to our presence. §H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§! has concluded that it is constructed of a form of §YLiving Metal§!.

descriptions.zh: 对在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的巨大神秘方块进行进一步调查反而带来了比答案更多的问题。它的外表面绝对光滑无缝，我们的扫描仪无法穿透。当我们靠近立方体时，它光洁壮观的立面突然轻轻泛起涟漪，响应着我们的出现。§H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§!得出结论，它是由前所未见的某种形式的怪异金属建造而成的。
descriptions.en: Closer inspection of the giant mysterious cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName] has raised more questions than answers. Its outer surfaces are perfectly smooth, seamless, and impenetrable to our scanners. As we approached the cube, the imposing facade seemed to ripple gently in response to our presence. §H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§! has concluded that it is constructed of a form of strange metal unlike any we have previously seen.

descriptions.zh:
§H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§!在检查[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的金属立方体时，其中一个表面突然泛起涟漪并且形成了一个通向该物体内部的开口。刚一进入，我们就发现了一个仍被腐坏的软体动物尸体占据着的控制台；不管它的肉体曾经如何，现在都化成了一抔黄土。

我们在控制台上发现了一个不寻常的容器，里面不时嘭哐作响似乎是有什么东西在里面活动。然而，这个容器的密封非常复杂，§H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§!目前还无法将其打开。
descriptions.en:
While §H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§! was examining the metallic cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName], one of its surfaces unexpectedly rippled and parted to create an opening into the object's interior. Upon entering, we found a command console still occupied by the husk of a decayed molluscoid; whatever flesh it may have once held has now decomposed into a pale dust.

On the console, we found an unusual container from which occasional thuds and dull clangs can be heard as if something is moving inside. However, the container's seal is complex and §H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§! has thus far been unable to open it.

label.zh: 我们肯定还能回收这些粉尘。
label.en: Surely we can still recover the dust.

descriptions.zh:
在对立方体中控台进行数据挖掘的过程中，§H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§!恢复并解码了两小段音频日志，里面是由同一位发言人发出的一连串咽喉喌音和刺耳的声门塞音。在语言学数据库中交叉检索后，§H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§!发现了一种与之相匹配的古代语言，并得出了第一份音频日志的能够理解的翻译：

§L“主席团们，请听我一言。要避免这场战争还有时间。你们君主的自信不过是浅薄而不慎重罢了，我们难道可以打败[event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName]吗。我们将会被覆灭的！”

“我们只可以安抚他们。这个匣子里装有一件礼物，可以作为和平的象征：这就是我们活体金属的精巧技艺。要想逃过这次劫难，只能将这件物送给他们。”§!
descriptions.en:
While data mining the cube's central console, §H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§! was able to recover and decrypt two short audio logs. They contain a series of guttural clicks and harsh glottal stops vocalized by a single speaker. By cross-referencing our linguistic database, §H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§! found a comparable ancient language and has produced a working translation of the first audio log:

§L'My presidium, you must hear me. There is still time to avoid this war. Your dynasts' confidence is injudicious, we cannot defeat [event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName]. They will destroy us!'

'Appeasement is our only option. My crate contains a gift, a likely token of peace: the secrets of our living metal mastery. The only way to avoid oblivion is to deliver it to them.'§!

descriptions.zh:
第二段来自立方体控制台的音频信息也翻译完成了。

§L“主席团们，我失败了。我们的覆灭已经在劫难逃了。

我的六面体太空船遭到破坏，将会尝试紧急着陆在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上。即便我侥幸存活，这件和平信物也无法送达了。[event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName]将如我们所恐惧的一般攻打我们。”§!

§H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§!已经完成匣子闭锁机构的破解。匣子里是一团异乎寻常的金属。它极具延展性和超响应性，不断地每过几秒就重塑成新的复杂外形。
descriptions.en:
The second audio log from the cube's command console has been translated.

§L'My presidium, I have failed. Our annihilation is imminent and inexorable.

My hexahedral spacecraft was sabotaged. I will attempt an emergency landing on [fromfrom.planet.GetName]. Even if I survive, the peace token will not be delivered. [event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName] will attack as we feared.'§!

§H[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]§! has successfully decoded the locking mechanism on the crate. Contained within is a peculiar nugget of metal. It is particularly malleable and hyperactive, endlessly reshaping itself into intricate new forms every few seconds.

descriptions.zh: 我们可以自己留着这个怪东西来加深我们对活体金属的理解，或是接替它的原主完成原定的事务；将其作为礼物送给[event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName]以改进我们与之的关系。
descriptions.en: We could retain this curiosity to further our understanding of living metal or we could do as its previous owners had intended; offer it as a gift to [event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName] in order to improve our standing with them.

descriptions.zh: 这件独特的物品和立方体舰船的来历可以加深我们对活体金属的理解。
descriptions.en: This remarkable item and the cuboid vessel it came from will be used to further our knowledge of living metal.

descriptions.zh: 这件独特的物品和立方体舰船的来历可以加深我们对金属化合物和结构的理解。
descriptions.en: This remarkable item and the cuboid vessel it came from will be used to further our knowledge of metallic compounds and structures.
